status: DRAFT - no licensed instrument or norm table has been obtained yet; never invent norms. Three Basira-authored tasks (published format, new items, raw score only) sit beside the still-pending originals (DECISIONS 2026-11-03).
licence_note: public_domain here means no third-party licence is needed (a public procedure or Basira-authored task); it does not mean the items are validated.

LICENSE PENDING: published visual agnosia screening protocol not yet named; a physician must confirm inclusion. No score is produced.

Raw score = proportion of phonological-awareness items correct (rhyme, blending, segmentation, syllables; Basira-authored, unreviewed). No norms exist yet, so no scaled score.
Raw score = words correct per minute on timed Basira passages (curriculum-based measurement, Deno 1985). No Arabic age-band WCPM norms are available yet, so no scaled score.
instruments.source: IDEA Stage 0 construct 7; Deno, S.L. (1985) Curriculum-based measurement: the emerging alternative. Exceptional Children 52(3), 219-232.

instruments.note_en: Raw score = proportion of 24 pattern-completion items correct (sequence, grid, analogy). Exclusionary use only; never report as an IQ. Basira-authored screening task, NOT STANDARDIZED and not the original test: entirely new items, so the original's norms do not apply. Items unreviewed until a specialist signs off.
instruments.source: Format: matrix reasoning (Raven, J.C. 1938, Progressive Matrices). Items: content/dist/stage0/nonverbal-pattern-basira-v0.json

instruments.note_en: Raw score = proportion of 24 items correct (shape mirror, letter mirror, non-mirror control). Supplementary only; reversals alone never indicate dyslexia. Compare the mirror blocks with the control block in the stored responses. Basira-authored screening task, NOT STANDARDIZED and not the original test: entirely new items, so the original's norms do not apply. Items unreviewed until a specialist signs off.
instruments.source: Format: mirror discrimination after Houbben & Vannuscorps (2022, GCPN Mons). Items: content/dist/stage0/orientation-basira-v0.json

instruments.note_en: Raw score = proportion of 28 items correct (dot counting, number comparison, addition); the reaction-time baseline is not scored. Response times stay in the stored responses.
